title: Refund policy
text: Refunds are available within 30 days for unused products. Refunds go to the original payment method and take 5-10 business days.

title: Shipping and tracking
text: Standard shipping takes 3-5 days; express shipping takes 1-2 days. Track your shipment using the tracking number in your shipping confirmation.

title: Password reset
text: A password reset link is valid for 1 hour. Each link is one-time use only.

title: Order cancellation
text: Order cancellation is allowed before shipping only. Once shipped, an order cannot be cancelled.

title: Invoices and disputes
text: Invoices are available in your billing history. Charge disputes must be submitted within 60 days.

title: Account closure
text: Account closure has a 7-day grace period. Account data is deleted after 30 days.

title: Email changes
text: To change your email, verify the new address. The verification link expires after 24 hours.

title: Product warranty
text: The product warranty lasts 1 year. It excludes accidental damage.
